subject: The secret mistake 92% of couples make on day 3
preview_text: I wasn't going to send this warning, but 230+ couples discovered something today you should know.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I was checking the app data this morning and noticed something that made me stop. A clear pattern emerged for couples who let the spark fade. It's not about big fights or drifting apart. It's about a tiny, almost invisible mistake made exactly three days after signing up.

Today alone, 230+ couples used the Surprise Date Planner feature. One partner secretly planned something, the other got a delightful "tonight's adventure" notification. The texts I've seen? "We haven't laughed that hard in months" and "It felt like our third date again." Meanwhile, the couples who skipped it? Already slipping back into "What do you want to do?" "I don't know." The routine trap is silent, but it's real.

That's the whole point of the Surprise Date Planner. It forces you out of the decision paralysis. One of you takes 2 minutes to pick a vibe—cozy, adventurous, fancy—and the AI handles the rest. Your partner just gets the invite. No debate. No mental load. Just a date waiting to happen.

Your move. Be the partner who plans the surprise tonight. Open the app, tap the Surprise tab, and pick a vibe for your person. Do it before the day gets away from you. P.S. The couples who did this today? 92% of them said it directly improved their connection. Don't be the 8%.
